thag5.9:1.1: Olaggessāmi te citta āṇidvāre va hatthinaṃ, na taṃ pāpe niyojessaṃ kāmajāla sarīraja. || ||
thag5.9:2.1: tvaṃ olaggo na gacchisi dvāravivaraṃ gajo va alabhanto, na ca cittakali punappunaṃ pasahan pāparato carissasi. || ||
thag5.9:3.1: yathā kuñjaraṃ adantaṃ navaggaham aṅkusaggaho balavā āvatteti akāmaṃ, evaṃ āvattayissan taṃ. || ||
thag5.9:4.1: yathā varahayadamakusalo sārathi pavaro dameti ājaññaṃ, evaṃ damayissan taṃ patiṭṭhito pañcasu balesu. || ||
thag5.9:5.1: satiyā taṃ nibandhissaṃ, payatatto vo damessāmi; viriyadhuraniggahīto na yito dūraṃ gamissase cittā 'ti. || || Vijitaseno thero.
